name: Wan Video Generation Archive
purpose: Generate short videos with Wan2.2 TI2V-5B on one GPU and keep every clip in Backblaze B2 with its prompt, seed, pinned model revision and license, archived by age and shared through expiring links.
tagline: Every generated clip stays findable, reproducible and labelled as it ages.

features.title: Clip Generation
features.summary: Wan2.2 text-to-video on one GPU, labelled AI-generated

features.title: Clip Library
features.summary: browse clips by project and tier with their manifest entries

features.title: Prompt-and-Seed Manifest
features.summary: per-project JSONL with prompt, seed, model revision, license and checksum

features.title: Archive Age Job
features.summary: move older clips to the archive prefix and update manifest keys

features.title: Share Links
features.summary: expiring presigned links for recent or archived clips

features.title: Regenerate from Manifest
features.summary: re-run a clip from its recorded prompt, seed and revision

features.title: Bucket Explorer
features.summary: browse, preview and download every object in the bucket

features.title: Metadata Extraction
features.summary: image dimensions, EXIF, PDF info, checksums in the explorer

features.title: Settings
features.summary: theme, default project and default share link lifetime

b2_surface.why: store a clip, its settings sidecar and the rewritten project manifest
read a project manifest or settings sidecar
verify an archive copy before removing the recent copy, and the /health probe
move a clip from video/recent/ to video/archive/ keeping its AI-generated metadata
drop the recent copy after a verified move, or delete a clip
list project manifests and back the full-bucket explorer
expiring share links and explorer downloads without a public bucket

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, Pydantic v2, Diffusers, PyTorch, imageio-ffmpeg

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**), shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, only when the bucket is public; share links never need it

env_vars.name: HF_TOKEN
env_vars.note: optional; both pinned models are public on huggingface.co

env_vars.name: HF_HOME
env_vars.note: local cache directory for model weights

env_vars.name: ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS
env_vars.note: age in days after which the age job archives a clip (default 30)

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: API origin when the web app runs on a different host; Next.js inlines it at build time
